_comment: Config for evaluate_endomapper.py / visualize_endomapper.py, matching the real downloaded EndoMapper layout under datasets/EndoMapper/{pseudoGT,colmap_benchmark_frames}/<patient_id>/<subseq_id>/.
_sequences_comment: null = auto-discover every "<patient_id>/<subseq_id>" that has both a COLMAP model and a frames dir (161 as of the first download batch, across 8 patients). Or give an explicit list, e.g. ["00033/13", "00034/14"].
_colmap_root_comment: data_root/colmap_root/<patient_id>/<subseq_id>/ holds the COLMAP reconstruction (cameras/images/points3D, under colmap_model_subdir as .bin, or directly as sibling .txt files).
_frames_root_comment: data_root/frames_root/<patient_id>/<subseq_id>/ holds the frame PNGs COLMAP's images.txt/bin NAME field refers to directly (no extra subdirectory prefix).
_colmap_model_subdir_comment: COLMAP's binary export lives one level deeper than the text export, in a numbered model directory (always "0" for every sequence seen so far). Falls back to the parent directory's .txt files if "0" isn't a valid model.
_min_points_per_frame_comment: Frames with fewer valid sparse points than this are skipped in evaluate_endomapper.py and flagged in visualize_endomapper.py's health summary.
_min_gt_depth_ratio_comment: Sparse COLMAP points with depth below this fraction of the frame's own median depth are dropped before computing errors -- filters out near-zero-depth triangulation artifacts (observed directly: one sequence had points at depth 0.018 against a frame median of ~21), which otherwise dominate sq_rel/RMSE since those metrics divide by gt. Applied to GT only, identically for every model.
_cameras_comment: EndoMapper cameras are OPENCV_FISHEYE. get_sparse_depth() samples COLMAP's actual detected keypoint pixels (not a re-projection through the distortion model), so this is correct regardless of undistortion.
_undistort_comment: SHADeS/SHADeS++ were trained on UNDISTORTED C3VD/Hyper-Kvasir frames (see prepare_data/README.md); raw fisheye EndoMapper video is a real train/inference domain gap. When true, each frame is undistorted with its own camera's OPENCV_FISHEYE params (datasets/colmap_utils.build_undistort_map) before inference, and GT sparse points are mapped into the same undistorted pixel space. Set false to compare against the old raw-frame behavior.
_undistort_balance_comment: cv2.fisheye's balance parameter: 0.0 = no black borders (some FOV cropped at the edges, matching training images which have no black borders); 1.0 = full original FOV kept, with black corners.
